util_intro: Twintrinsic ships a small set of shared helper functions used by the Form select family (AutoComplete, Listbox, Combobox) and the group components (TagGroup, ChipGroup). They are re-exported from the package entry point, so you can import them alongside components:
util_intro2: All helpers accept an item plus an optional field name used to derive the label or value when the item is an object. Always pass the field name explicitly when your objects use a custom key — the helpers default to "label" / "value".
util_getitemlabel_body: Derives a display label for an item. Primitives are stringified as-is; objects yield item[labelField], with null/undefined field values collapsing to "". This unifies the former per-component ?.toString() || "" label pattern.
util_getitemvalue_body: Derives a comparison/submission value for an item. Objects yield item[valueField]; primitives pass through unchanged. Falsy primitives ("", 0, false, null, undefined) are intentionally not collapsed — so a numeric option 0 survives selection comparison.
util_dispatchgroupremove_body: Resolves the item at index from the items array and invokes the group's remove/dismiss callback with a CustomEvent whose detail carries '{'item, index'}' . Shared by TagGroup ("dismiss") and ChipGroup ("remove").
util_detectlanguage_body: Heuristically detects a code language from content patterns (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, JSON, YAML, Markdown, Svelte, shell). Used by CodeBlock when no language prop is provided.
util_propstable_body: For rendering component props and events in your own docs, Twintrinsic ships two utility components — PropsTable and EventsTable. They auto-derive their rows from a component module at build time, with an explicit-array fallback. See their dedicated pages for full usage:
